description: Success-path notation: `compose symbols` / a dense read tool answering "what does this feature already declare" in one line per fact. AGENTOUT-2 only fires when something is WRONG; the other constant agent question is what already exists, and today answering it means re-reading feature.json, the folder, the gate log and the links, then re-deriving facts compose already computed. Emit one line per fact — status, phase, complexity, artifacts present/absent, gate state, links and their expect/actual, lifecycle position — with a kind letter deliberately disjoint from AGENTOUT-2's severity letters so a merged stream is never ambiguous. Include the stable feature code as the coordinate (compose already has content identity where Axiom needed to invent NID). Payoff claim to test, not assume: Axiom reports that making the success path greppable immediately exposed a parser bug that pretty-printed output had been absorbing for the life of the project. Prior art: Axiom AXSYM, docs/diagnostics.md.
